Definition: Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Hukkok is a town on the border of Naphtali, given to the Levites as a city of their inheritance. The name appears twice, once in the border list and once in the list of Levitical towns. It is a boundary town, and its place in the record is a place on the map.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hukkok matters because even a border town is part of the inheritance, and God gives His servants a place in the land.
